meta.scope: All endpoint pairs and direct station pairs found in the downloaded Renfe AV/LD/MD feed, plus selected verified OUIGO, iryo, FGC and SNCF services. Not a complete inventory of every independent regional railway. Cercanías, metro, tram and tourist-only trains are outside this directory.
meta.timing_note: Renfe durations are the observed minimum–maximum of published schedules, combining both directions and stopping patterns. Other operators show their own indicative times separately. A feed entry does not guarantee a train runs on a chosen date.
meta.distance_note: The Renfe feed does not publish railway distances. Only separately supplied line lengths or explicitly labelled planning estimates are displayed; missing distances are not replaced with straight-line values.
